description:
Add a built-in claude runner type so users don't need to write wrapper scripts. Extend RunnerConfigSchema with a new discriminated variant: type: 'claude', model (default: 'claude-opus-4-7'), optional systemPrompt override. Implement ClaudeRunner in src/runner/claude.ts implementing AgentRunner.

The runner renders a prompt from AgentRunInput: task description, issue/PR title and body, relevant comment thread, and git instructions (repo checked out at OTTO_REPO_PATH, commit your changes, one branch only). Calls: claude -p "<rendered prompt>" --output-format json --model <model> with OTTO_REPO_PATH as cwd. Parse the JSON output to extract the result text as the summary.

Ship a default system prompt that instructs Claude to: implement the requested change, commit with a clear message, print a brief plain-text summary of what was done (suitable for posting publicly — no secrets, no paths). The default prompt lives in src/runner/claude-prompt.ts and can be overridden per-runner in config.

Update config schema, loader, and the runner factory so 'type: claude' instantiates ClaudeRunner instead of CommandRunner.
title: Built-in Claude CLI runner with prompt template
